formal_results: Recursive Origins checks every original core/mixed node: full-cell source certificates at leaves, endpoint origins at units, both children at compositions, and retained child evidence at attachment
Folded cell certificates are derived structurally without substituting them for the recursive origin obligations
Native operation producers compute full parameters from framed producers and construct compiled endpoints, actual retained compose/attach histories and their native bridges
Dependent whole-Body paths and full native Closure paths match each generated operation to its actual original node, including dependent attachment routing
An exact traversal certifies both subtrees and each local raw history, bridge and endpoint output; extracted program lists match the entire actual native packet
A common-witness CertifiedTree combines original source origins, prior recursive native recovery evidence, the actual root producer and all packet entries for the same unchanged tree
The actual named forward endpoints instantiate a core composition, mixed join and derived attachment in the original certified initial context

interface.source_discipline: Recursive certified actual-input obligations, not a pure initial-word-only global script or a function producing Origins for every admitted Tree
interface.leaf_parameters: A full-cell certificate exhibits a framed producer and full matching path; native operation evaluation recomputes its parameters from that producer
interface.parent_consumption: Parents consume compiled child cells. Child raw histories and bridges remain separately present in the recursive packet and prior history evidence.
interface.matching: Dependent equality of whole indexed Bodies, hence exact native Closure matching; raw histories are matched to generated raw histories, never identified with compiled endpoint packages
interface.intermediate_origins: Both composition children are traversed, including imported core trees; unit objects and shared intermediate endpoints cannot be omitted
interface.scope: Finite mixed trees with explicit Origins evidence, including their actual retained root and all local native bridges

open_typed_boundaries: Construct certified-input producers for the full root-history comparison boundaries and their higher envelopes
Assemble the final common-witness theorem with the bounded policy compiled-target interface and existing forward context
Do not infer unchecked tree certification, unrestricted raw-policy iteration or a context-free global Body action
